value.text: {"sql": "SELECT local_day, usgs_peak_cfs, usgs_peak_hour_cdt, nwm_at_usgs_peak_cfs, nwm_peak_cfs, nwm_peak_hour_cdt, lag_hours, peak_error_cfs FROM (SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS hr_cdt, usgs_northport_peak_cfs AS usgs_peak_cfs, nwm_cfs AS nwm_at_usgs_peak_cfs, MAX(nwm_cfs) OVER (PARTITION BY local_day) AS nwm_peak_cfs, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(MAX(hr_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY local_day), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS nwm_peak_hour_cdt, (hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(MAX(hr_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY local_day), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) - hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago'))) AS lag_hours, (MAX(nwm_cfs) OVER (PARTITION BY local_day) - usgs_northport_peak_cfs) AS peak_error_cfs FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc >= '2026-10-23 05:00' AND hr_utc < '2026-10-25 05:00' AND usgs_northport_peak_cfs IS NOT NULL AND nwm_cfs IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY local_day, usgs_peak_cfs, usgs_peak_hour_cdt, nwm_at_usgs_peak_cfs, nwm_peak_hour_cdt HAVING MAX(usgs_peak_cfs) > 1000 ORDER BY local_day LIMIT 200", "purpose": "Quantify NWM performance on Oct 23–24 CDT: peak flow, timing lag vs USGS 15-min peak, and magnitude error at peak hour and at NWM peak hour"}
